title: Commuting exact coefficient cubes lift to bounded below derived comparisons
statement: Let B,C,B′,C′,B₀,C₀,B₀′,C₀′ be abelian categories with derived categories, and assume enough injectives in B,B′,B₀,B₀′. Let G:B→C, H:B′→C′, G₀:B₀→C₀, H₀:B₀′→C₀′ be additive. Let P:B→B′, Q:C→C′, P₀:B₀→B₀′, Q₀:C₀→C₀′, U:B→B₀, V:C→C₀, U′:B′→B₀′ and V′:C′→C₀′ be exact additive functors. Suppose e:G⋙Q→P⋙H, e₀:G₀⋙Q₀→P₀⋙H₀, a:G⋙V→U⋙G₀, b:H⋙V′→U′⋙H₀, c:V⋙Q₀≅Q⋙V′ and d:U⋙P₀≅P⋙U′ satisfy V′(e_F);b_{PF};H₀(d_F⁻¹)=c_{GF}⁻¹;Q₀(a_F);e₀_{UF} for every F. Write R(e),R(e₀),R(a),R(b) for the canonical rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange comparisons, and Dc,Dd for the exact derived lifts using composition isomorphisms. Then for every K, DV′(R(e)_K);R(b)_{DP(K)};RH₀(Dd_K⁻¹)=Dc_{RG(K)}⁻¹;DQ₀(R(a)_K);R(e₀)_{DU(K)}. This is a formal lifting statement conditional on underived cube commutativity, with no geometric or coefficient assumptions.

proof.text: Form the two natural transformations from RG⋙DQ⋙DV′ to DU⋙DP₀⋙RH₀. Precompose with the RG unit whiskered by DQ and DV′. Use rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange_fac for each of the four faces, and mapDerivedCategoryPlusCompIso_hom_app_factorsh plus mapDerivedCategoryPlusNatIso_hom_app_factorsh for c and d. Naturality of the RH₀ unit moves the exact comparisons to the termwise maps. The assumed equation, applied termwise to bounded below complexes and then mapped through Qh, makes these composites equal.

RG followed by the arbitrary functor DQ⋙DV′ is an absolute right derived functor, by isRightDerivedFunctor_rightDerivedFunctorPlus_comp_right. Apply rightDerived_ext to the equality after its unit, and evaluate at K. No coefficient functor is assumed to preserve injectives.

theorem rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange_cube
    (e : G ⋙ Q ⟶ P ⋙ H) (e₀ : G₀ ⋙ Q₀ ⟶ P₀ ⋙ H₀)
    (a : G ⋙ V ⟶ U ⋙ G₀) (b : H ⋙ V' ⟶ U' ⋙ H₀)
    (c : V ⋙ Q₀ ≅ Q ⋙ V') (d : U ⋙ P₀ ≅ P ⋙ U')
    (h : ∀ F : B, V'.map (e.app F) ≫ b.app (P.obj F) ≫ H₀.map (d.inv.app F) =
      c.inv.app (G.obj F) ≫ Q₀.map (a.app F) ≫ e₀.app (U.obj F))
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus B) :
    D+(V').map ((rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange e).app K) ≫
        (rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange b).app (D+(P).obj K) ≫
        R+(H₀).map (((mapDerivedCategoryPlusCompIso U P₀).symm ≪≫
          mapDerivedCategoryPlusNatIso d ≪≫ mapDerivedCategoryPlusCompIso P U').inv.app K) =
      ((mapDerivedCategoryPlusCompIso V Q₀).symm ≪≫
        mapDerivedCategoryPlusNatIso c ≪≫ mapDerivedCategoryPlusCompIso Q V').inv.app
          (R+(G).obj K) ≫
        D+(Q₀).map ((rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange a).app K) ≫
        (rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange e₀).app (D+(U).obj K)
